notes.title: Update coming in on Dec 2nd - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Check out the first major update to Battle Arena: Euro Wars - over 30 Steam achievements. 

They are grouped into 6 categories: Unity, Commune, Flag, Point, Personal and Battle.

-[b]Unity [/b]- 5 achievements for taking out members of the Commune team.
-[b]Commune [/b]- 5 achievements for taking out members of the Unity team.
-[b]Flag [/b]- 5 achievements for taking and retaking own and enemy flags.
-[b]Point [/b]-  4 achievements for reaching certain levels of points. 
-[b]Personal [/b]- 7 achievements for carring our special attacks on enemies by certain characters.  
-[b]Battle  [/b]- 5 achievements for general performance during gameplay. 

[b]Get it now![/b]
